premises.text: Diabetes care is inadequate because manual logging is tedious, digital tools are incompatible, and no support-network platform exists
premises.evidence_span: proper care for diabetes is inadequate and in many countries broken due to the following usability and technical problems

premises.text: A smart audio-jack cable connects the majority of existing glucometers to smart devices without buying new meters
premises.evidence_span: this smart cable is compatible with majority of the glucometers in the market, even those in emerging markets

premises.text: App workflow color-codes readings, tags meals/meds, and logs contextual factors for interpretable graphs and doctor sharing
premises.evidence_span: the app color codes some of the readings purple or orange if certain numbers are out of range

premises.text: Partner function lets remote family view stats, send encouragement, and set alerts for missed syncs or out-of-range numbers
premises.evidence_span: I from Taiwan can use any one of my smart devices and view her stats

premises.text: Patient-centric platform enables third-party interactions such as insurers and pharmacies
premises.evidence_span: enabling new forms of interaction with third parties to the patient

domains.name: Legacy meter smart cable and app

value.text: Patients regain control of glucose management with usable connected tools
value.evidence_span: Health to Sync aggregates glucose data, ultimately giving control back to you

causal_links.evidence_span: proper care for diabetes is inadequate
taking legacy devices, bringing them to the digital age, and making them smarter
data availability to the support network

notes: Three problem bullets folded into one broken-care premise. App UI details folded into P3. Family bio motivates but is not coded as a team premise. Indiegogo ask excluded.
